#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

#include <cstdio>
using namespace std;

long long compute(int n, int m) {
    if (n > 2) {
        return (long long)n * m / 2 * 2;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        return m / 6 * 6 + 2 * max(m % 6 - 3, 0);
    }
    switch (m) {
        case 2:
            return 0;
        case 3:
            return 4;
        case 7:
            return 12;
        default:
            return 2 * m;
    }
}

int main() {
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    if (n > m) {
        swap(n, m);
    }

    cout << compute(n, m) << endl;
    return 0;
}
